verses.zh: 瘟疫之后，耶和华晓谕摩西和祭司亚伦的儿子以利亚撒说：
verses.en: [NOTE:1] After the plague the Lord said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest,[NOTE:2]
notes: The breakdown of ch. 26 for outlining purposes will be essentially according to the tribes of Israel. The format and structure is similar to the first census, and so less comment is necessary here.
The MT has also “saying.”

verses.zh: 「你们要将以色列全会众，按他们的宗族，凡以色列中从二十岁以外、能出去打仗的，计算总数。」
verses.en: “Take a census of the whole community of Israelites, from twenty years old and upward, by their clans,[NOTE:1] everyone who can serve in the army of Israel.”[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “house of their fathers.”
Heb “everyone who goes out in the army in Israel.”

verses.zh: 摩西和祭司以利亚撒在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边向以色列人说：
verses.en: So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the rift valley plains[NOTE:1] of Moab, along the Jordan River[NOTE:2] across from Jericho.[NOTE:3] They said,
notes: The term עַרְבוֹת (ʿarevot) refers to the sloping plain of the rift valley basin to the north of the Dead Sea and east of the Jordan. See the note at Num 21:1.
The word “River” is not in the Hebrew text, but has been supplied in the translation for clarity (also in v. 62).
For the location of Jericho see Map5-B2; Map6-E1; Map7-E1; Map8-E3; Map10-A2; Map11-A1.

verses.zh: 「将你们中间从二十岁以外的计算总数」；是照耶和华吩咐出埃及地的摩西和以色列人的话。
verses.en: “Number the people[NOTE:1] from twenty years old and upward, just as the Lord commanded Moses and the Israelites who went out from the land of Egypt.”
notes: “Number the people” is added here to the text for a smooth reading.

verses.zh: 以色列的长子是流便。流便的众子：属哈诺的，有哈诺族；属法路的，有法路族；
verses.en: Reuben was the firstborn of Israel. The Reubenites: from[NOTE:1] Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; from Pallu, the family of the Palluites;
notes: The Hebrew text has no preposition here, but one has been supplied in the translation for clarity. Cf. vv. 23, 30, 31, 32.

verses.zh: 属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族；属迦米的，有迦米族；
verses.en: from Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; from Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

verses.zh: 这就是流便的各族；其中被数的，共有四万三千七百三十名。
verses.en: These were the families of the Reubenites; and those numbered of them were 43,730.

verses.zh: 法路的儿子是以利押。
verses.en: Pallu’s descendant[NOTE:1] was Eliab.
notes: The MT has “and the sons of Pallu.”

verses.zh: 以利押的众子是尼母利、大坍、亚比兰。这大坍、亚比兰，就是从会中选召的，与可拉一党同向耶和华争闹的时候也向摩西、亚伦争闹；
verses.en: Eliab’s descendants were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. It was Dathan and Abiram who as leaders of the community rebelled against Moses and Aaron with the followers[NOTE:1] of Korah when they rebelled against the Lord.
notes: Or “company” (so KJV, NASB, NRSV); Heb “congregation.”

verses.zh: 地便开口吞了他们，和可拉、可拉的党类一同死亡。那时火烧灭了二百五十个人；他们就作了警戒。
verses.en: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah at the time that company died, when the fire consumed 250 men. So they became a warning.

verses.zh: 然而可拉的众子没有死亡。
verses.en: But the descendants of Korah did not die.

verses.zh: 按着家族，西缅的众子：属尼母利的，有尼母利族；属雅悯的，有雅悯族；属雅斤的，有雅斤族；
verses.en: The Simeonites by their families: from Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; from Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; from Jakin, the family of the Jakinites;

verses.zh: 属谢拉的，有谢拉族；属扫罗的，有扫罗族。
verses.en: from Zerah,[NOTE:1] the family of the Zerahites; and from Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
notes: This is “Zohar” in Exod 6:15 and Gen 46:10.

verses.zh: 这就是西缅的各族，共有二万二千二百名。
verses.en: These were the families of the Simeonites, 22,200.

verses.zh: 按着家族，迦得的众子：属洗分的，有洗分族；属哈基的，有哈基族；属书尼的，有书尼族；
verses.en: The Gadites by their families: from Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; from Haggi, the family of the Haggites; from Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

verses.zh: 属阿斯尼的，有阿斯尼族；属以利的，有以利族；
verses.en: from Ozni,[NOTE:1] the family of the Oznites; from Eri,[NOTE:2] the family of the Erites;
notes: The MT of Gen 46:16 reads this as “Ezbon.”
The Greek version and Smr have “Ad[d]i,” probably by confusion of letters.

verses.zh: 属亚律的，有亚律族；属亚列利的，有亚列利族。
verses.en: from Arod,[NOTE:1] the family of the Arodites; and from Areli, the family of the Arelites.
notes: Gen 46:16 and the LXX here read “Arodi.”

verses.zh: 这就是迦得子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有四万零五百名。
verses.en: These were the families of the Gadites according to those numbered of them, 40,500.

verses.zh: 犹大的儿子是珥和俄南。这珥和俄南死在迦南地。
verses.en: The descendants of Judah were Er and Onan, but Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

verses.zh: 按着家族，犹大其余的众子：属示拉的，有示拉族；属法勒斯的，有法勒斯族；属谢拉的，有谢拉族。
verses.en: And the Judahites by their families were: from Shelah, the family of the Shelahites; from Perez, the family of the Perezites; and from Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

verses.zh: 法勒斯的儿子：属希斯伦的，有希斯伦族；属哈母勒的，有哈母勒族。
verses.en: And the Perezites were: from Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; from Hamul,[NOTE:1] the family of the Hamulites.
notes: Smr and the Greek version have “Hamuel.”

verses.zh: 这就是犹大的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有七万六千五百名。
verses.en: These were the families of Judah according to those numbered of them, 76,500.

verses.zh: 按着家族，以萨迦的众子：属陀拉的，有陀拉族；属普瓦的，有普瓦族；
verses.en: The Issacharites by their families: from Tola, the family of the Tolaites; from Puah, the family of the Puites;

verses.zh: 属雅述的，有雅述族；属伸仑的，有伸仑族。
verses.en: from Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; and from Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

verses.zh: 这就是以萨迦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万四千三百名。
verses.en: These were the families of Issachar, according to those numbered of them, 64,300.

verses.zh: 按着家族，西布伦的众子：属西烈的，有西烈族；属以伦的，有以伦族；属雅利的，有雅利族。
verses.en: The Zebulunites by their families: from Sered, the family of the Sardites; from Elon, the family of the Elonites; from Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

verses.zh: 这就是西布伦的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有六万零五百名。
verses.en: These were the families of the Zebulunites, according to those numbered of them, 60,500.

verses.zh: 按着家族，约瑟的儿子有玛拿西、以法莲。
verses.en: The descendants of Joseph by their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

verses.zh: 玛拿西的众子：属玛吉的，有玛吉族；玛吉生基列；属基列的，有基列族。
verses.en: The Manassehites: from Machir, the family of the Machirites (now Machir became the father of Gilead); from Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

verses.zh: 基列的众子：属伊以谢的，有伊以谢族；属希勒的，有希勒族；
verses.en: These were the Gileadites: from Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; from Helek, the family of the Helekites;

verses.zh: 属亚斯烈的，有亚斯烈族；属示剑的，有示剑族；
verses.en: from Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; from Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

verses.zh: 属示米大的，有示米大族；属希弗的，有希弗族。
verses.en: from Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; from Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

verses.zh: 希弗的儿子：西罗非哈没儿子，只有女儿。西罗非哈女儿的名字就是玛拉、挪阿、曷拉、密迦、得撒。
verses.en: Now Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, but only daughters; and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

verses.zh: 这就是玛拿西的各族；他们中间被数的，共有五万二千七百名。
verses.en: These were the families of Manasseh; those numbered of them were 52,700.

verses.zh: 按着家族，以法莲的众子：属书提拉的，有书提拉族；属比结的，有比结族；属他罕的，有他罕族。
verses.en: These are the Ephraimites by their families: from Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; from Beker, the family of the Bekerites; from Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

verses.zh: 书提拉的众子：属以兰的，有以兰族。
verses.en: Now these were the Shuthelahites: from Eran, the family of the Eranites.

verses.zh: 这就是以法莲子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有三万二千五百名。按着家族，这都是约瑟的子孙。
verses.en: These were the families of the Ephraimites, according to those numbered of them, 32,500. These[NOTE:1] were the descendants of Joseph by their families.
notes: This is a significant reduction from the first count of 40,500.

verses.zh: 按着家族，便雅悯的众子：属比拉的，有比拉族；属亚实别的，有亚实别族；属亚希兰的，有亚希兰族；
verses.en: The Benjaminites by their families: from Bela, the family of the Belaites; from Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; from Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

verses.zh: 属书反的，有书反族；属户反的，有户反族。
verses.en: from Shupham,[NOTE:1] the family of the Shuphamites; from Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
notes: With the exception of a few manuscripts the MT has Shephupham. The spelling in the translation above is supported by Smr and the ancient versions.

verses.zh: 比拉的众子是亚勒、乃幔。属亚勒的，有亚勒族；属乃幔的，有乃幔族。
verses.en: The descendants of Bela were Ard[NOTE:1] and Naaman. From Ard,[NOTE:2] the family of the Ardites; from Naaman, the family of the Naamanites.
notes: The LXX has Adar. Cf. 1 Chr 8:3.
“From Ard” is not in the Hebrew text.

verses.zh: 按着家族，这就是便雅悯的子孙，其中被数的，共有四万五千六百名。
verses.en: These are the Benjaminites, according to their families, and according to those numbered of them, 45,600.

verses.zh: 按着家族，但的众子：属书含的，有书含族。按着家族，这就是但的各族。
verses.en: These are the Danites by their families: from Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These were the families of Dan, according to their families.

verses.zh: 照其中被数的，书含所有的各族，共有六万四千四百名。
verses.en: All the families of the Shuhamites according to those numbered of them were 64,400.

verses.zh: 按着家族，亚设的众子：属音拿的，有音拿族；属亦施韦的，有亦施韦族；属比利亚的，有比利亚族。
verses.en: The Asherites by their families: from Imnah, the family of the Imnahites; from Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; from Beriah, the family of the Beriahites.

verses.zh: 比利亚的众子：属希别的，有希别族；属玛结的，有玛结族。
verses.en: From the Beriahites: from Heber, the family of the Heberites; from Malkiel, the family of the Malkielites.

verses.zh: 亚设的女儿名叫西拉。
verses.en: Now the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.[NOTE:1]
notes: Also mentioned in 1 Chr 7:30.

verses.zh: 这就是亚设子孙的各族，照他们中间被数的，共有五万三千四百名。
verses.en: These are the families of the Asherites, according to those numbered of them, 53,400.

verses.zh: 按着家族，拿弗他利的众子：属雅薛的，有雅薛族；属沽尼的，有沽尼族；
verses.en: The Naphtalites by their families: from Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; from Guni, the family of the Gunites;

verses.zh: 属耶色的，有耶色族；属示冷的，有示冷族。
verses.en: from Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; from Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

verses.zh: 按着家族，这就是拿弗他利的各族；他们中间被数的，共有四万五千四百名。
verses.en: These were the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those numbered of them were 45,400.

verses.zh: 以色列人中被数的，共有六十万零一千七百三十名。
verses.en: These were those numbered of the Israelites, 601,730.

verses.zh: 耶和华晓谕摩西说：
verses.en: Then the Lord spoke to Moses:

verses.zh: 「你要按着人名的数目将地分给这些人为业。
verses.en: “To these the land must be divided as an inheritance according to the number of the names.

verses.zh: 人多的，你要把产业多分给他们；人少的，你要把产业少分给他们；要照被数的人数，把产业分给各人。
verses.en: To a larger group you will give a larger inheritance,[NOTE:1] and to a smaller group you will give a smaller inheritance.[NOTE:2] To each one its inheritance must be given according to the number of people in it.[NOTE:3]
notes: Heb “to many you will multiply his inheritance.”
Heb “to a few you will lessen his inheritance.”
Heb “according to those that were numbered of him,” meaning, in accordance with the number of people in his clan.

verses.zh: 虽是这样，还要拈阄分地。他们要按着祖宗各支派的名字承受为业。
verses.en: The land must be divided by lot; and they will inherit in accordance with the names of their ancestral tribes.

verses.zh: 要按着所拈的阄，看人数多，人数少，把产业分给他们。」
verses.en: Their inheritance must be apportioned[NOTE:1] by lot among the larger and smaller groups.”
notes: Heb “divided.”

verses.zh: 利未人，按着他们的各族被数的：属革顺的，有革顺族；属哥辖的，有哥辖族；属米拉利的，有米拉利族。
verses.en: And these are the Levites who were numbered according to their families: from Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; from Merari, the family of the Merarites.

verses.zh: 利未的各族有立尼族、希伯伦族、玛利族、母示族、可拉族。哥辖生暗兰。
verses.en: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

verses.zh: 暗兰的妻名叫约基别，是利未女子，生在埃及。她给暗兰生了亚伦、摩西，并他们的姊姊米利暗。
verses.en: Now the name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, daughter of Levi, who was born[NOTE:1] to Levi in Egypt. And to Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and Miriam their sister.
notes: Heb “who she bore him to Levi.” The verb has no expressed subject. Either one could be supplied, such as “her mother,” or it could be treated as a passive.

verses.zh: 亚伦生拿答、亚比户、以利亚撒、以他玛。
verses.en: And to Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

verses.zh: 拿答、亚比户在耶和华面前献凡火的时候就死了。
verses.en: But Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire[NOTE:1] before the Lord.
notes: This event is narrated in Lev 10:1-7.tn The expression אֵשׁ זָרָה (ʾesh zarah, “strange fire”) seems imprecise and has been interpreted numerous ways (see the helpful summary in J. E. Hartley, Leviticus [WBC 4], 132-33). The infraction may have involved any of the following or a combination thereof: (1) using coals from some place other than the burnt offering altar (i.e., “unauthorized coals” according to J. Milgrom, Leviticus [AB], 1:598; cf. Lev 16:12 and cf. “unauthorized person” [אִישׁ זָר, ʾish zar] in Num 16:40 [17:5 HT], NASB “layman”), (2) using the wrong kind of incense (cf. the Exod 30:9 regulation against “strange incense” [קְטֹרֶת זָרָה, qetoret zarah] on the incense altar and the possible connection to Exod 30:34-38), (3) performing an incense offering at an unprescribed time (B. A. Levine, Leviticus [JPSTC], 59), or (4) entering the Holy of Holies at an inappropriate time (Lev 16:1-2).

verses.zh: 利未人中，凡一个月以外、被数的男丁，共有二万三千。他们本来没有数在以色列人中；因为在以色列人中，没有分给他们产业。
verses.en: Those of the Levites[NOTE:1] who were numbered were 23,000, all males from a month old and upward, for they were not numbered among the Israelites; no inheritance was given to them among the Israelites.
notes: Heb “them”; the referent has been specified in the translation for clarity.

verses.zh: 这些就是被摩西和祭司以利亚撒所数的；他们在摩押平原与耶利哥相对的约旦河边数点以色列人。
verses.en: These are those who were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the Israelites in the rift valley plains[NOTE:1] of Moab along the Jordan River opposite Jericho.[NOTE:2]
notes: This is the area of the rift valley basin to the north of the Dead Sea and east of the Jordan. See the note at Num 21:1.
For the location of Jericho see Map5-B2; Map6-E1; Map7-E1; Map8-E3; Map10-A2; Map11-A1.

verses.zh: 但被数的人中，没有一个是摩西和祭司亚伦从前在西奈的旷野所数的以色列人，
verses.en: But there was not a man among these who had been[NOTE:1] among those numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when they numbered the Israelites in the desert of Sinai.
notes: “who had been” is added to clarify the text.

verses.zh: 因为耶和华论到他们说：「他们必要死在旷野。」所以，除了耶孚尼的儿子迦勒和嫩的儿子约书亚以外，连一个人也没有存留。
verses.en: For the Lord had said of them, “They will surely die in the wilderness.” And there was not left a single man of them, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
